interface.shortDescription: Operate Baota (BT) Linux panel 13.0 via MCP
interface.longDescription: Routes Kimi to operate Baota (BT) Linux panel 13.0 through the MCP protocol. Diagnoses sites/databases/services, audits security, manages Docker/SSL/cron/firewall, and drives 98 panel tools. The plugin ships no local MCP server — connect your Kimi client to a remote Baota MCP endpoint at port 8765 with Bearer Token auth.
